title: CSF: Contextual Safety Filtering for Motion Generators
why_read: A concrete robotics safety method with real hardware validation, relevant to anyone working on physical AI agents.
analysis: This paper introduces a training-free safety filter for robot motion generators that uses control-barrier-function-style optimization to block unsafe motions based on scene context, such as distinguishing touching an object versus touching a person. It is tested on four different pretrained motion generators and demonstrated on a real Unitree G1 humanoid robot, showing up to 90% reduction in dangerous actions while preserving most benign motions. This is a practical contribution to robot safety that doesn't require retraining or labeled data, which is appealing for deployment-focused robotics engineers.
